recommendation: Select the active LR successor for the A4.1 cost/availability target. Preserve the original Wurth as fallback. Do not use obsolete non-LR as a new baseline.

rejected_related_part.reason: The exact non-LR related-product suggestion has ended production. Its price is not applied to the LR part.

normal_load_calculation.model: Ideal continuous conduction buck; reference-temperature copper loss only. The 0.5A case adds planning headroom for logic to the approximate0.4A output regime; it is not a final verified total-current bound.
normal_load_calculation.excluded: Frequency tolerance/FSS corners, core loss, DCR temperature rise, inductance bias, efficiency, startup/transients and hot-short waveform.

fault_qualification.finding: Typical TDK Isat3.5A is above buck3.1A maximum, but a typical number is not a guaranteed minimum over temperature and lot. The paper review does not prove no significant saturation during upstream short/startup.
fault_qualification.protection_scope: The downstream TPS2552-1 LED latch does not bound a fault on the unswitched buck rail. AP63205 cycle current limiting and hiccup reduce fault energy but do not independently validate this inductor and PCB.
fault_qualification.close_with: Final power-loop/land-pattern review, startup and upstream/downstream short measurements at the selected input/ambient extremes, with current waveform and inductor/regulator temperature. Retain Wurth fallback if margin is inadequate.

layout_qualification.height_result: 2.0mm max body preserves the existing body-height target; solder height and placement clearance still apply.
layout_qualification.footprint_result: Use the exact TDK recommended land pattern. Similar body size does not establish compatibility with the original Wurth footprint; the native layout has not been generated or compared.
layout_qualification.assembly_process_note: TDK specifies no cleaning agents; the final PCBA process must comply.

cost_scope: Fitted components at displayed tiers only. Excludes attrition, MOQ/pre-purchase minimums, PCB, assembly/setup/extra processing, harness, enclosure, freight and taxes.

sources.supports: Production status; dimensions and typical electrical parameters.
